title: Analytic: slab n_eff vs thickness off the grid, subpixel smoothing (em_modes)
description:
Cross-section modes (em_modes, mode_analysis at 1.55 um) of a silicon slab in silica, periodic x (4 cells), CPML along y, uniform 10 nm cells. The slab centre sits 0.37 cells off a cell edge and the sweep steps its thickness d_slab by 3 nm (0.3 cells) from 205 to 235 nm, so its two edges cross the cells at ever other sub-cell positions. solver_defaults.subpixel_smoothing is on: interface cells and faces get the Kottke-averaged permittivity (arithmetic for the tangential E_x of TE0, harmonic for the normal E_y of TM0).
Analytic: TE0 u tan(u) = w, TM0 u tan(u) = (eps_si / eps_sio2) w, u = kappa d / 2, u^2 + w^2 = V^2, V = k0 (d/2) sqrt(eps_si - eps_sio2); neff_te / neff_tm are solved in the parameters by 5 Newton steps. Below the TE1 cutoff (~245 nm) the table holds TE0 (row 0) and TM0 (row 1).
Sweep tab: n_eff_TE0 and n_eff_TM0 vs d_slab with the dashed dispersion: with smoothing a smooth curve ~1e-3 (TE0) / ~2e-3 (TM0) below the closed form (Yee dispersion at ~29 cells per wavelength in silicon, second order). Switch smoothing off (Solvers node, Smooth material interfaces) to compare: the staircase holds n_eff constant while no cell centre changes side and jumps by up to ~1e-2 when one does.
Derived values tab (last value, 235 nm): the same with reference and relative error, te_fraction 1 (TE0) and 0 (TM0).

parameters.name: lambda0
parameters.description: vacuum wavelength of the mode solve

parameters.name: eps_si
parameters.description: silicon core permittivity (n = 3.480)

parameters.name: eps_sio2
parameters.description: silica cladding permittivity (n = 1.444)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: d_slab
parameters.description: slab thickness (swept 205-235 nm in 3 nm steps)

parameters.name: Ly
parameters.description: domain height (CPML beyond)

parameters.name: y_slab
parameters.description: slab centre line, off the cell edges

parameters.name: V_slab
parameters.description: normalised frequency V = k0 (d/2) sqrt(eps_si - eps_sio2)

parameters.name: u_te0
parameters.description: TE start value of u = kappa d / 2

parameters.name: u_te1
parameters.description: TE Newton step 1 on u - atan(w / u) = 0

parameters.name: u_te2
parameters.description: TE Newton step 2

parameters.name: u_te3
parameters.description: TE Newton step 3

parameters.name: u_te4
parameters.description: TE Newton step 4

parameters.name: u_te5
parameters.description: TE Newton step 5 (converged to machine precision)

parameters.name: neff_te
parameters.description: analytic n_eff of the fundamental TE (E_x along the slab) mode

parameters.name: r_tm
parameters.description: TM boundary factor n_core^2 / n_clad^2

parameters.name: u_tm0
parameters.description: TM start value of u, between the root and V (convex: Newton descends from the right; uncapped it passes V below d = 220 nm)

parameters.name: u_tm1
parameters.expression: u_tm0 - (u_tm0 - atan(r_tm*sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm0**2)/u_tm0))/(1 + r_tm*V_slab**2/(sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm0**2)*(u_tm0**2 + r_tm**2*(V_slab**2 - u_tm0**2))))
parameters.description: TM Newton step 1 on u - atan(r w / u) = 0

parameters.name: u_tm2
parameters.expression: u_tm1 - (u_tm1 - atan(r_tm*sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm1**2)/u_tm1))/(1 + r_tm*V_slab**2/(sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm1**2)*(u_tm1**2 + r_tm**2*(V_slab**2 - u_tm1**2))))
parameters.description: TM Newton step 2

parameters.name: u_tm3
parameters.expression: u_tm2 - (u_tm2 - atan(r_tm*sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm2**2)/u_tm2))/(1 + r_tm*V_slab**2/(sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm2**2)*(u_tm2**2 + r_tm**2*(V_slab**2 - u_tm2**2))))
parameters.description: TM Newton step 3

parameters.name: u_tm4
parameters.expression: u_tm3 - (u_tm3 - atan(r_tm*sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm3**2)/u_tm3))/(1 + r_tm*V_slab**2/(sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm3**2)*(u_tm3**2 + r_tm**2*(V_slab**2 - u_tm3**2))))
parameters.description: TM Newton step 4

parameters.name: u_tm5
parameters.expression: u_tm4 - (u_tm4 - atan(r_tm*sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm4**2)/u_tm4))/(1 + r_tm*V_slab**2/(sqrt(V_slab**2 - u_tm4**2)*(u_tm4**2 + r_tm**2*(V_slab**2 - u_tm4**2))))
parameters.description: TM Newton step 5 (converged to machine precision)

parameters.name: neff_tm
parameters.description: analytic n_eff of the fundamental TM (E_y normal to the slab) mode
